items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: And we were like racecar drivers too. Miles had his Ferraris and stuff, Gabor and I had Ferraris and stuff like that later on. There were a lot of painters, I can't think of all the names now, but it was a beautiful scene because [Dorothy speaks in the background] Arthur Monroe, I showed him his painting of Arthur back there. Arthur studied with... Who did he study with honey? Was it Dacuny? [Dorothy speaks again]... I had a lot of paintings in New York. I even had some Franz Kline man, I had stuff on the wall,…
